added.summary: Every og.Water is crossed like an og.WaterSurface: a body or character whose centre crosses a lake's level, a sea's waves or a river's course is an og.Splash, without an og.WaterSurface on the entity. Which side each body near a water is on is world state, saved and restored with the simulation.

It answers for every og.Water: a lake without a `wind` answers its level and a river its course (both were refused), a sea its waves as before, each with the waves bodies raised on an og.WaterSurface on the same entity. An og.Water drawn over a mesh (`geometry`) is still refused.

A hull floats on a river as on a lake or a sea, and cuts the water it sits in on all three. An og.Water alone still lifts only og.Buoyancy bodies; og.WaterSurface and og.WaterLine keep lifting every body's box by their `buoyancy`.
